 """Evaluation of small arithmetic formulas."""
 
 from collections.abc import Mapping
+import re
 
 
 class EvalError(ValueError):
     """The formula is malformed or cannot be evaluated."""
 
 
+_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"""
+    (?P<NUMBER>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)
+    | (?P<NAME>[a-zA-Z_]\w*)
+    | (?P<OP>[+\-*/%^])
+    | (?P<LPAREN>\()
+    | (?P<RPAREN>\))
+    | (?P<COMMA>,)
+    | (?P<SKIP>\s+)
+    | (?P<OTHER>.)
+""", re.VERBOSE)
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str):
+    if not formula or formula.strip() == "":
+        raise EvalError("Empty formula")
+
+    raw = []
+    for m in _TOKEN_RE.finditer(formula):
+        kind = m.lastgroup
+        if kind == "SKIP":
+            continue
+        if kind == "OTHER":
+            raise EvalError(f"Unexpected character: {m.group()!r}")
+        raw.append((kind, m.group()))
+
+    if not raw:
+        raise EvalError("Empty formula")
+
+    tokens = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(raw):
+        if raw[i][0] == "NAME" and i + 1 < len(raw) and raw[i + 1][0] == "LPAREN":
+            tokens.append(("FUNCTION", raw[i][1]))
+        else:
+            tokens.append(raw[i])
+        i += 1
+
+    return tokens
